In this paper we concentrate on the N 2 D [+] (3-2) line (with a rest frequency of 231.32 GHz), the highest-density tracer in our spectral set-up as it clearly shows the most complete structure of the high-density narrow filament in the LBS23 region.

In this paper, we will focus on the central region because of its comparative simplicity, significantly lower stellar feedback activity, and the relative young age of the filament and the sources in it.
